quests.name: Rats in the Walls
quests.description: The general shop's cellar is crawling with giant rats, and the infestation runs deeper than any cellar should — down into a cave system nobody knew was there.

steps.name: Clear the cave under the shop
steps.description: Put down the giant rats swarming the cave beneath the general shop.

steps.name: Clear out the basement nests
steps.description: The basement nests feed the cave below. Destroy them or the cellar refills within a season.

steps.name: Hunt down the strays around Hollowmere
Evict the goblin squatters
steps.description: Goblins have been slipping into one of Hollowmere's houses after dark — and where goblins nest, rats follow. Drive them out.

quest_giver.start_dialog: Twelve years I've kept this shop and I have never once been beaten on a price — but I am being beaten by rats. Big ones, coming up through the basement faster than I can trap them, and I'd stake my black book it started with those goblins sneaking around after dark. Clear them out, top to bottom, and Mira Hask pays her debts.
quest_giver.end_dialog: A whole cave system. Under my shop. Twelve years standing on top of that, and not one supplier thought to mention it. The cellar's mine again, and your name goes in my book — the good column, which I'll have you know is the shorter one.

quests.name: The Grotto Below
quests.description: The rat infestation traces back to a goblin grotto north of town — and the goblins have been tunneling toward Hollowmere. Break the warren before the town wakes up with a basement it didn't dig.

steps.name: Clear the squatters from the upper grotto
Recover what the goblins stole
steps.description: The goblins took something from the town vault — the mayor is oddly vague about what. Find it in the lower grotto and bring it back unopened.

quest_giver.start_dialog: Goblins. In the grotto. Tunneling toward MY town, under MY shop district, on MY year as mayor. The Hask woman's rats were the warning and nobody listened, well, I'M listening, and I'm hiring. Break the warren, get back what they took from the vault, and try not to read anything you find down there. Town business stays town business.
quest_giver.end_dialog: You came back. Walking, even. I'll be honest, the town pool had you floating past the mill by Thursday — I lost three silver on you, and I have never been happier to lose money. The item goes back in the vault, the goblins go in the town record as 'resolved,' and you go on the list of people Hollowmere owes. It's a short list. We pay it.

quests.name: The Second Hole
quests.description: There's another grotto north of the goblin warren, and nobody in Hollowmere can say what's in it — which, lately, is reason enough to find out.

steps.name: Sound the grotto, top to bottom
steps.description: Walk every level of the second grotto and find out whether the holes connect.

quest_giver.start_dialog: Forty years of soldiering teaches you one thing worth keeping: it's never the hole you know about. There's a second grotto north of the goblin warren, and every soul in town walks past it like it isn't there. Go down it. All the way down. I'd go myself, but my knees signed a separate peace years ago.
quest_giver.end_dialog: So it's deep, and it's ugly, and now we know — which puts Hollowmere ahead of every town that found out the other way. You've done old Harl a kindness and the town a service. The town doesn't know it yet. They never do until the hole's full of something.

quests.name: Into the Dark Wood
quests.description: The old forest north of Hollowmere goes in further than it goes across, and the deeper paths stop being forest at all. Nobody has walked it end to end and said so afterward.

steps.name: Walk the Dark Wood to its end
steps.description: Map the wood level by level — through the deep boughs, the strangle-green, and whatever the paths become after that.

quest_giver.start_dialog: I came down from the fire mountains chasing a story: a wood that goes in further than it goes across, with old treasure where the paths stop behaving. My clan's singers say never walk a wrong wood alone, and I am — observe — alone. Walk it with me to the end. Whatever we find, we split. Whatever finds us, we share that too.
quest_giver.end_dialog: A winter clearing at the bottom of a summer wood. The singers will call me a liar, and I'll be rich enough not to care. You've earned your half — and a verse in the song, if I survive the singing of it.

quests.name: Pirates in Hollowmere
quests.description: Pirates — actual pirates, this far from any honest sea — have been raiding Hollowmere, and the trail runs through the town's least savory inn.

steps.name: Stop the raiders in the streets
Burn out the hideout under the inn

quest_giver.start_dialog: Pirates! In Hollowmere! We are NOWHERE NEAR THE SEA, friend, I checked — twice — and yet my entire troupe was robbed at cutlass-point not thirty paces from that lake. A jester knows misdirection when he's mugged by it: nobody sails to a lake. They're coming from somewhere, and my coin — what's left of it — says it's that unsavory inn.
quest_giver.end_dialog: My hero! My champion! My single remaining solvent acquaintance! The troupe returns tomorrow and the show goes on — juggling, tumbling, and a brand-new comic ballad entitled 'The Day the Pirates Picked the Wrong Lake.' You feature heavily. I'd pay you, but the town owes you and I AM the town's entertainment, so in a sense, you're already collecting. Bye bye!

quests.name: Wolves on the Tradeway
quests.description: The packs squatting on the road south of Varnfell aren't hunting deer — they're holding the road. Break them so the sledges can run again.

steps.name: Drive the wolf packs off the tradeway
steps.description: Hunt down the wolf packs lairing in the snowfields around Varnfell.

quest_giver.start_dialog: Twenty years trapping this country and I've never seen wolves hold a road like soldiers. Two packs, dug in on the tradeway, and every sledge in Varnfell stuck behind them. Clear them out and Sela can move her ledgers from red ink back to black.
quest_giver.end_dialog: Both packs broken — and you walked back out, which is better than the last three who tried. The tradeway's open. First sledge south carries word that Varnfell's still in business, and that's your doing.

quests.name: The Drowned Cargo
quests.description: A trade-sealed crate has washed up on the sand south of Varnfell. Sela Varn wants it back before the sea — or whatever paces the shore at night — takes it first.

steps.name: Recover the crate from the southern shore
steps.description: Find the trade-sealed crate Maro spotted on the sand south of town and bring it back. Something has been pacing that stretch of shore at night.

quest_giver.start_dialog: Maro logged a crate on the south sand — trade-sealed, which means it was bound for this post, which means it's mine. I'd send someone, but everyone I'd send is either behind this counter or buried. Bring it back whole and Varn and Daughters will remember you in the ledger, the good column.
quest_giver.end_dialog: The seal's my grandmother's mark — this crate left here forty years ago and the sea's only now giving it back. I don't know whether to thank you or apologize to you. Take this and we'll call it both.

quests.name: Into the Frost Delve
quests.description: The abandoned digging south of Varnfell has started breathing warm air. Henna Stone wants to know what's moved in below before it decides to move up.

steps.name: Explore the Frost Delve
steps.description: Descend the old workings and find the source of the warm air.

quest_giver.start_dialog: That delve was dead cold for nine years while I worked it, and dead quiet for twenty after. Now it breathes warm and the snow won't settle on the ridge. Go down, both levels, all the way to the warm dark — and come back and tell an old miner what's woken up under her town.
quest_giver.end_dialog: So the cracks do keep going down. I knew it — knew it when the company packed up, knew it every warm night since. You've bought Varnfell something nobody's had up here in a long while: warning. The town owes you, and so do I.
